Notes.Text:
This update for PackageKit fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-104619: PackageKit ZYpp rollback vulnerability (bsc#1284389).
- CVE-2026-104620: local privilege escalation by any local user can call `InstallFiles` with the `SIMULATE` flag without
  a `polkit` check (bsc#1284954).
